text: I have a Bank of America credit card with a balance on it. All payments are up to date and I pay above the minimum. About half of the balance is under a 0 % interest promotion the bank provided. The other half has a 24.2 % ( usurious if you ask me ) rate. I pay above the minimum and notice all that money goes to the 0 % balance and none to the 24 % balance so every month, my interest payment rises even though I have made above-minimum payments and charged nothing more to the card -- my overall balances are lower. Is this legal? Do the banks decide where they want to apply the money sent to them so they can maximize the interest charged to me? It certainly seems unfair.
